note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

parser.reason: TypeScript: ts/src/zon.ts has one import from '@tabnas/parser' of `Tabnas`, `Rule`, `Plugin`, `Context`, `Config`, `TabnasOptions` and `Lex`; it is a value import for `Tabnas` (`new Tabnas().use(jsonic).parse(grammarText)` in `Zon`) and type-only for the other six, and ts/package.json lists @tabnas/parser in peerDependencies. Rust: `use tabnas::{...}` in rs/src/lib.rs and lex.rs, and `pub use tabnas::TabnasError as ZonError` in lib.rs, with `tabnas` (package tabnas-parser) in [dependencies] of rs/Cargo.toml. Go: no .go file under go/, test files included, imports github.com/tabnas/parser/go, and go/go.mod carries the parser as `// indirect`. go/zon.go imports no tabnas module but github.com/tabnas/jsonic/go. Where TypeScript constructs the engine itself, zon.go gets one from jsonic's own `Make` (`jsonic.Make().Parse(text)` in `parseGrammarText`, `jsonic.Make()` in `MakeJsonic`), and names the engine's types through the aliases in jsonic's go/engine.go (`jsonic.Jsonic`, `jsonic.Rule`, `jsonic.Context`, `jsonic.Lex`, `jsonic.LexConfig`, `jsonic.Token`, `jsonic.GrammarSpec`).
parser.repair: To agree on having it: go/zon.go would import github.com/tabnas/parser/go for the engine types it now takes from jsonic, and the parser line in go/go.mod would become a direct require. To agree on not having it: ts/src/zon.ts would take `Tabnas`, and the types `Rule`, `Context`, `Config` and `Lex`, from @tabnas/jsonic, which re-exports them under the same names (jsonic's ts/src/jsonic.ts), `TabnasOptions` under the name `Options` (jsonic's ts/src/types.ts), and the engine's `Plugin` under the name `TabnasPlugin` (`export type { Plugin as TabnasPlugin } from '@tabnas/parser'`), because jsonic's own `Plugin` type is a different one whose first argument is a `Jsonic` instance; ts/package.json would then drop the @tabnas/parser peer. In Rust that move is not available today: tabnas-jsonic re-exports only `TabnasError` (as `JsonicError`), so jsonic's rs/src/lib.rs would first have to re-export the engine's items before rs/src here could take them from it and rs/Cargo.toml drop `tabnas` from [dependencies]. Either way the engine stays in every port's build, because jsonic depends on it in all three (peerDependencies of its ts/package.json, the import in its go/engine.go, [dependencies] of its rs/Cargo.toml). The handover page parser/doc/handover/README.md of 2026-10-04 does not raise this difference, but item 3 of its "Decisions waiting on the maintainer" proposes trying `use(json)` in place of `use(jsonic)` in zon: that edits the same `new Tabnas().use(jsonic)` call, and the second direction relies on @tabnas/jsonic remaining a dependency of the TypeScript port. Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
